君に剣を預けておくと言ってしばらく経つが、
あれからどうだ、学ぶことはあったか？
text.official_en:
Some time ago I told you I'd allow you to keep that
sword. Tell me. Have you learned anything since?

of my opponents have reached me.

emotions of others through conversation too.

Gods and humans have lost their way. The natural
order has deteriorated. It's verging on mayhem.
